made_for: issue 1752 Gate 2 Clean-Slate Sci-Fi Calibration Pack (Ryan, Nov 22 2026; supersedes Gate 1 pilot1585; ready for Astra and Fable pressure-test)
note: Clean-slate dark space/sci-fi audio pack covering all 26 weapons in godot/rules/data/tables.json, all 4 target armor substances (metal, glass, bio, obsidian), shield collapses, R416 mid-battle breach and capability-loss cues (#1741), all faction death beats, intuitive sci-fi UI cues, seamless bridge ambience, and 2 multi-section music prototypes. Strictly space/sci-fi (no ocean/naval words), zero muffled 'soft top' suffix, zero pre-delay mechanics inside t=0 shot clips, zero literal domestic foley traps. Stems stay off in Gate 2 (enabled in Gate 3 on picked songs).

items.cue: battle music prototype (Sunward multi-section tactical score)
items.prompt: Dark atmospheric sci-fi space fleet tactics orchestral and electronic score for a dying-star war, 94 BPM, D minor. Built around a memorable austere four-note recurring motif played on weathered low brass and bowed cello. Evolving three-part structure: begins tense and restrained with brooding low cellos, cold metallic glass harmonics, and a subtle pulsing sub-synth heartbeat; develops at 0:30 into taut tactical drive with layered mid-brass chords and crisp restrained industrial sci-fi percussion; rises at 0:58 into a solemn, powerful brass-and-string climax with rhythmic urgency before resolving smoothly back into dark atmospheric tension. Inspired by Homeworld and Battlestar Galactica tactical dread. Distinct harmonic movement, real emotional weight, evolving harmonic score, no vocals.

items.cue: reward screen music prototype (dying-sun salvage cadence)
